name: paraguay-payroll
description: Paraguay payroll for private-sector employees in 2026: the two minimum wages of the year (G 2,899,048 a month to 30 June under Decreto N° 4122/2025 and G 3,044,000 from 1 July 2026 under Decreto N° 6225/2026 and Resolución MTESS N° 670/2026), the daily, hourly, night, part-time and apprentice minimums, working hours, overtime at 50%, night work at 30%, night overtime and holidays at 100%, the aguinaldo (13th salary, one twelfth of the year's pay, before 31 December, free of IPS and IRP), the family allowance (5% of the minimum wage per child), the payslip, permitted deductions, gross-to-net with the 9% IPS withholding, the employer's cost, and why a private employer withholds no income tax (IRP) from salaries. Also holidays, notice and the dismissal indemnity. Trigger on: Paraguay payroll, planilla de sueldos, salario mínimo 2026 Paraguay, aguinaldo, sueldo neto, horas extras Paraguay, bonificación familiar, asignación familiar, costo del empleado Paraguay.
